note:
Media for the tosijs-product doc site, hosted here so the consuming repo does not carry ~15 MB of binaries in git AND in its GitHub Pages payload (docs/ is committed and served from main). Provenance is deliberately understated rather than asserted: agent-owl.mp4 is AI-generated (a Veo watermark is visible in frame), macbook_neo.glb arrived without recorded provenance, and only tosi-platform.json is unambiguously ours. Treat all four as demo material, not as a licensed asset pack — if any of it is ever reused outside the doc site, establish provenance first.

agent-owl_10x10_96.jpg is a mosaic derived from agent-owl.mp4 by `bunx tosi-mosaic`; both ship because <tosi-filmstrip> and the <video currentTime> scene demonstrate the two different techniques side by side.

agent-owl_scrub.mp4 (4.0 MB) is agent-owl.mp4 (10.3 MB) re-encoded for scroll scrubbing — no audio, a keyframe every 12 frames (0.5 s) so a backward seek decodes at most 11 frames instead of up to 4 s, SSIM 0.959 against the original:
  ffmpeg -i agent-owl.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -crf 28 -g 12 -keyint_min 12 -sc_threshold 0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart agent-owl_scrub.mp4
The original stays published: its URL is cached immutable and older pages still point at it.

macbook_neo_web.glb (1.3 MB) is macbook_neo.glb (2.5 MB) with its three baseColor JPEGs swapped for smaller ones; geometry bufferViews are byte-identical. Body/keyboard 4096² -> 2048² (sips -Z 2048 -s formatOptions 85; the key legends stay legible), screen 2048² -> 1024² (a soft gradient), brushed-metal 1024² untouched. The original stays published.
